title: IFF opens Brazil Forest Lab to find new fragrance and beauty ingredients
summary: IFF Forest Lab in Legado das Águas, Brazil’s largest private Atlantic Forest reserve, will house scientists and perfumers as they study the ingredient opportunities across the 31,000 hectare region

extraction.key_fact: IFF가 브라질 대서양림 보호구역에 향료와 뷰티 원료를 찾는 연구 거점 포레스트 랩을 열었다.
